both.statement: A machine part is destroyed by reducing its HP die to zero.
both.quotedFromA: A machine part is destroyed by reducing its HP die to zero.
both.quotedFromB: A machine part is destroyed when its HP die is reduced to zero.

both.statement: When a machine part is destroyed, its card is removed from play.
both.quotedFromA: When a machine part is destroyed, its card is removed from play.
both.quotedFromB: When a machine part is destroyed, remove its card from play.

both.statement: When a machine part is destroyed, that part's die is added to the destroying player's permanent dice pool.
both.quotedFromA: When a machine part is destroyed, that part's die is added to the destroying player's permanent dice pool.
both.quotedFromB: When a machine part is destroyed, add its die to your permanent dice pool.

both.statement: A die newly added to the permanent pool is set aside with the player's other spent dice, and stays set aside until the start of the next turn.
both.quotedFromA: A die newly added to the permanent pool is set aside with the player's other spent dice, and stays set aside until the start of the next turn.
both.quotedFromB: Destroyed part dice are set aside with other spent dice until the start of the next turn.

both.statement: A player's permanent dice pool can never hold more than ten dice.
both.quotedFromA: A player's permanent dice pool can never hold more than ten dice.
both.quotedFromB: You can never have more than 10 dice in your permanent dice pool.

both.statement: The permanent pool's maximum includes black dice, capped at five.
both.quotedFromA: The permanent pool's maximum includes black dice, capped at five.
both.quotedFromB: The permanent pool maximum includes 5 black dice.

both.statement: The permanent pool's maximum includes yellow dice, capped at five.
both.quotedFromA: The permanent pool's maximum includes yellow dice, capped at five.
both.quotedFromB: The permanent pool maximum includes 5 yellow dice.

both.statement: After a machine part card is removed, the remaining machine part cards in play are shifted to close the gap left behind.
both.quotedFromA: After a machine part card is removed, the remaining machine part cards in play are shifted to close the gap left behind.
both.quotedFromB: After a machine part is destroyed, remaining machine part cards in play are shifted to close the gap.

both.statement: Some machine part cards carry a yellow X icon together with an associated effect.
both.quotedFromA: Some machine part cards carry a yellow X icon together with an associated effect.
both.quotedFromB: Some machine part cards have a yellow X icon and an effect.

both.statement: A card's yellow-X destroy effect triggers and is resolved immediately at the moment that part is destroyed.
both.quotedFromA: A card's yellow-X destroy effect triggers and is resolved immediately at the moment that part is destroyed.
both.quotedFromB: Yellow X effects on machine parts are triggered and resolved immediately when that part is destroyed.

both.statement: One sample machine part card's destroy effect deals one damage to every machine part currently in play.
both.quotedFromA: One sample machine part card's destroy effect deals one damage to every machine part currently in play.
both.quotedFromB: Machine parts can have an effect that deals 1 damage to all parts in play.

aOnly.statement: A destroy effect is printed on the card in a yellow banner bearing a circled-X icon, across the card's lower area.
aOnly.sourceSentence: a yellow banner with a circled-X icon reading "DEAL 1 DMG TO ALL PARTS IN PLAY", with an arrow pointing to a sample teal machine part card that shows the same yellow destroy-effect banner across its lower area.

aOnly.statement: A machine part card's layout includes a title bar, a column of cycle-track icons down its left side, and yellow roll-condition tiles on its right side.
aOnly.sourceSentence: The sample card also shows its title bar, a cycle track column of icons down the left, and yellow roll-condition tiles on its right side.
